title: AdapterCapabilityFlag
description: One optional power of the adapter contract: interactivePrompts, partialMessages, providerQueue (the provider holds messages sent during a turn), steering (it folds one into the running turn), resume, fork, rewind, sessionListing, subagents (delegated work it can stop), subagentTranscripts, titleRead, titleWrite, transcriptDelete, planUsage, liveModels, commands, imageInput, fileInput.
